user.title: Connect to Curiosa
user.description: In your Curiosa admin, press "Link Home Assistant". Copy the site address and the 8-character code shown there.

data_description.code: Example: ABCD2345. A code works for 10 minutes.
data_description.developer_mode: Leave off, unless you are testing at home. Allows an address on your own network.

reauth_confirm.title: Link again
reauth_confirm.description: Curiosa no longer accepts this link ({host}). In your Curiosa admin, ask for a new code, then type it here.

error.invalid_address: This address does not look right. Example: https://my-site.com
error.https_required: The address must start with https://
error.private_address: This is an address on your own network. Use your public site address, or turn on test mode.
error.invalid_code_format: The code has 8 letters and digits. Example: ABCD2345
error.invalid_code: This code is not right. Check it, or ask for a new one in Curiosa.
error.code_expired: This code is too old. Ask for a new one in Curiosa (it works for 10 minutes).
error.too_many: Too many tries. Wait a few minutes, then ask for a new code.
error.not_found: Curiosa did not answer at this address. Is the Home Assistant module turned on in your site?
error.cannot_connect: The site does not answer. Check the address and your internet.
error.unknown: Something went wrong. Try again in a moment.

init.title: Curiosa settings
init.description:
Your links (action word -> scene or script):
{bindings}

add_binding.title: Add a link
add_binding.description: Choose the action word that Curiosa sends, and the scene or script it starts at home. Example: lights:red starts scene.red.

data_description.key: Small letters, digits and : _ - only. Example: lights:red

tts.title: Voice
tts.description: Choose where messages are read aloud. Leave the speaker empty to turn reading off. Only this speaker is used.

data_description.tts_language: Optional. Example: fr-FR. Empty = the voice's own language.
data_description.tts_volume: Optional. Empty = keep the speaker's volume. The volume stays changed after the message.

error.invalid_key: Use small letters, digits and : _ - only (40 characters max). Example: lights:red
error.reserved_key: Words starting with tts: are used for reading aloud. Choose another word.
error.duplicate_key: This action word already has a link. Remove it first.
error.invalid_target: Choose a scene or a script.
error.invalid_language: This language does not look right. Example: fr-FR

reauth_needed.message: Curiosa no longer accepts this link. Link it again.

site_error.message: The site answered with an error ({status}). New try soon.

cannot_reach.message: The site does not answer. New try soon.

bad_address.message: The saved address is not safe (https is required).
